en: The *Sūtra on the Life-Span of Beings* Spoken by the Buddha.
In the thirteenth year of the Zhenguan era, the Tripitaka Master of the Tang dynasty traveled to the Western Heavens to seek the teachings.

While examining the Great Canon (*Tripitaka*), he discovered one fascicle of the *Sūtra on the Life-Span of Beings*, which contains twelve signs for determining whether one will be born as a human being in Jambudvīpa.
Previously, at the Underworld, each person borrowed "life-earning money" (shòushēng qián) from the appointed officials of destiny; they merely bowed to people and said, "I have seen it.
Now that the treasury is empty, they urge the sentient beings of Jambudvīpa to pay their life-earning money.
Ānanda again asked the World-Honored One, "The sentient beings of Jambudvīpa have many great vows, yet they cannot comprehend them. The Buddha spoke of the Way and its teachings.

If one reads the *Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra* and the *Śòushēng Jīng*, it can reduce the "destiny money" (*bìngmìng qián*) required for one's life; this serves as proof that the power of these scriptures is truly great.

If sentient beings do not offer the Śòushēng money, they will experience terror while sleeping, their dreams will be inverted, their three *hún* spirits will vanish into obscurity, and their seven *pò* spirits will sink into darkness.
They will hear the voices of deceased persons from the empty space of the subtle realm, who will pursue them, seize their *hún* and *pò* souls, and extinguish their lives.

Spiritual merit serves as the currency for longevity in rebirth. If there are good men or good women who purchase this longevity currency through the *pangnan* (side-entry) method, they shall avoid the eighteen kinds of calamities that befall one’s person.

First, the calamity of being waylaid and robbed by evil persons on distant roads or marshes; second, the calamity of being struck by wind, hail, or rain on distant roads; third, the calamity of crossing rivers...
The fourth is the calamity of falling into the water while crossing a river; the fifth is the calamity of walls collapsing and houses tumbling down;
the sixth is the calamity of fire; the seventh is the calamity of bloodshed; the eighth is the calamity of debilitating illness; the ninth is the calamity of scabies and leprosy;
the tenth is the calamity of the throat becoming obstructed; the eleventh is the calamity of being injured by falling from a horse; and the twelfth is the calamity of being crushed by a carriage.
The twelfth calamity: death from wounds; the thirteenth calamity: death in childbirth;
the fourteenth calamity: untimely death; the fifteenth calamity: sudden onset of apoplexy; the sixteenth calamity: epidemic diseases;
the seventeenth calamity: falling into wells or committing suicide by hanging; the eighteenth calamity: legal disputes and verbal strife.
If there are good men or good women who purchase and accept the *shousheng qian* (money for longevity), they will be exempt from the eighteen kinds of calamities that befall their persons.

If there are those who do not purchase or accept the *shousheng qian*, in future lives they will be frequently marked as poor and lowly, their lifespans will be short, they will be unsightly and unfitting, and they will suffer many physical disabilities. One need only look at the *Zhousheng jing* (Sutra on Marking Longevity) to see this.
This is the *Sūtra on Receiving Birth*, a true scripture that is not false; it eliminates calamities related to body and life, and spares one from misfortunes related to body and life.

It further speaks of the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas of the Ten Stages: the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva King of Longevity, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva King of Extended Life, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Increaser of Merit and Longevity, and the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Dispeller of Calamities and Obstacles, who contemplates and rescues those in suffering and distress.
Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva Mahāsattva, Long-Anle Bodhisattva Mahāsattva, Long-Huanxi Bodhisattva Mahāsattva,
Jie-Yuñjie Bodhisattva Mahāsattva, Fushouwang Bodhisattva Mahāsattva, Yanshouchang Bodhisattva Mahāsattva, and the local deities, dragon spirits,
and earth-lords of one’s original home shall cause all transgressions to be extinguished and fulfill the household members within the home.
The sins of evil speech and frivolous talk are extinguished; the sins of killing and taking life are extinguished;

the karmic enmities of past lives are extinguished; the karmic enmities of this life are extinguished; the offenses against parents of past lives are extinguished; the offenses against parents of this life are extinguished.
Furthermore, it is said that the calamitous stars—Venus, Jupiter, Mercury, Mars, and Saturn—[are likewise pacified].
After this confession, may the malefic stars—Yangxing, Taiyin, Rahula, Jidu, Ziqi, and Yuebei—not shine upon you, and may the auspicious luminaries long preside over you.
May you be free from illness throughout the four seasons and free from calamity during the eight nodes of the year.
If there are good men or good women who wish to pay for their longevity and birth, they should clearly explain their [karmic] leaks and offer even small, humble contributions.
From the time this scripture is received and stored in the treasury until one’s life ends at the age of a hundred, if it is burned early before the completion of the seventh week of mourning,
it shall deliver the parents of the three generations and the deceased ancestors of seven generations, as well as the vengeful spirits of the nine clans,
so that they all attain rebirth in heaven. Whether they be Confucian scholars, monks, nuns, or laypeople— whether noble or lowly— if there are good sons or good daughters...

If a woman burns *shou-sheng* money early in this life, she will enjoy wealth and honor throughout three lifetimes; if she does not burn it in this life, she will suffer poverty and low status throughout three lifetimes.

In future lives, it will be difficult for her to obtain a human body; even if she does become human, she may have crippled hands or feet, lack eyesight, have a hunched back, or suffer from idiocy, deafness, and muteness.
Her clothing will not cover her form and her food will not fill her mouth, and she will be treated with contempt by others. If she had burned *shou-sheng* money early on...

The money-bestowing deity, the clothing-bestowing deity, the food-bestowing deity, the life-span-bestowing deity, the destiny-bestowing deity, the natal star official, the natal destiny adjudicator, the King of Asuras, and the Eight Classes of Devas and Dragons, having heard what the Buddha had spoken, were all greatly rejoiced; they believed, accepted, and practiced it accordingly.
The *Sūtra Spoken by the Buddha on Longevity and Birth* then recited the mantra as follows:
Heavenly Net Mantra, Earth Net Mantra, Sun and Moon Yellow Net Mantra: May all enemies depart from my body! Mahāprajñāpāramitā.
First, the Sutra for Resolving Enmity; Second, the Mantra for Extending Life; Third, the Expiation of the Five Heinous Crimes.
By reciting this sutra, one shall avoid the retribution of hell and immediately attain rebirth in heaven; it is not in vain.
